sloka: अथ रात्र्याम् प्रपन्नायाम् कालरात्र्यामिआत्मनः ।अर्धरात्रे दशरथह् कौसल्यामिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-४२-३२॥
transliteration: atha rātryām prapannāyām kālarātryāmiātmanaḥ ।ardharātre daśarathah kausalyāmidamabravīt ॥2-42-32॥

translations.english: Oh how fortunate are those best of men who will live until that time to see Rama return and embrace him.
